name: nh3h2o_absorption_recirculation
title: Single-stage ammonia-water absorption cycle with absorber recirculation and condensate precooler
summary: Single-stage NH3H2O absorption refrigeration cycle, Herold, Radermacher and Klein Example 9.6: condensate precooler between the condenser and evaporator outlets, absorber solution recirculation heated to the poor-solution saturation temperature (state 15), and preheating of the rich solution by the rectifier coolant; all 16 state points, the component heat rates and the COP are computed.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (any three of T, P, X, Q, H, S, U, V)
PROCEDURE shx (kept; Min() = smaller of two capacity rates)

origin.notes: Example 9.6 of Herold, Radermacher and Klein, Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, CRC Press, 2nd ed., 2015; EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Case_Study/). The .eez companion stores the binary .EES with the solution used as verification reference. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples.

verification.summary: The native file was solved in CoolSolve and compared with the EES stored solution (compare_solution.py --ees-units, 132 common variables): COP within 0.53 %, heat rates within 1.1 %, temperatures within 0.9 %, mass fractions within 3.4 %. Whole-cycle balance closes to 2.3e-7 W. Deviations explained by the NH3H2O property backend (identical calls differ up to 3.2 %); absolute h and s excluded (reference-state offsets).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the binary Ex9_6.EES inside ex9_6.eez (ees_variables.csv), compared with tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units; direct NH3H2O property calls at identical inputs quantify the backend difference
verification.notes: Compared set: 132 common variables. Excluded: h[i], swp, s[i] (absolute NH3H2O enthalpy/entropy, different reference state in EES and CoolProp; the EES s[1..14], v[2..14] and Q[2]/Q[5]/Q[11]/Q[14] records are stale, the file computes none of them), checkQ (balance residual: EES 1.2e-4 W, CoolSolve 2.3e-7 W on 460 kW), cp_1011/cp_1314/cp_163 (reference units J/g-K not converted by --ees-units, CS-BUG-COMPARE-JGK; true diffs 3.8e-03, 5.1e-03, 2.1e-02). Max kept rel diff as printed: x[4] 3.34e-02; COP_1 5.27e-03; P_low 2.13e-02; Q_dot_evap 1.06e-02.

related_external: EES-Community/ees-examples Case_Study ex9_1 to ex9_5 (single-stage NH3H2O absorption family, Herold chapter 9)
